capacity_scope: Equal width is not equal parameter count across ordinary/analytic/LIF/Transformer. Counts are reported explicitly; this is a common data/update budget comparison, not a matched-parameter architecture comparison.
dormancy_scope: Unchanged arrays are retained and identified rather than rejected or rerun. LIF surrogate gradients do not equal the derivative of its hard-forward loss. Dormancy is a training result, not proof of an intrinsically untrainable architecture.
hash_contract: Batch-stream hash is SHA256 of the ordered concatenation of raw 32-byte logged batch hashes. Array hashes cover C-order raw bytes; shape/dtype are recorded separately.
initialization_scope: No initial-array equality is assumed or claimed across different architectures. Equal seed does not imply equal architecture initialization. The earlier primary audit separately established ordinary/analytic pair equality.
scope: Read-only 108 completed training runs; no training or evaluation performed; no test data or metrics opened.
